sources.title: Novva Data Centers: Utah Data Center page (version modified 10 September 2026)
sources.summary: Novva's Utah page says 'Our accessible, sustainable, safe, and secure Utah data center is located near Salt Lake City in West Jordan, UT' and calls it its flagship data center, 'spanning 100 acres with 1.5 million square feet of purpose-built data center space'. It publishes 2025 monthly water usage reports and states 'Novva uses ~394,667 gallons/month (4.7 million gallons/year)'; its specifications list an annualized PUE of 1.18, on-site 24x7 staffing, a 100% uptime SLA, 200,000 sq ft of white floor space, an on-site 200 MW substation, waterless cooling and four purpose-built data centers in a four-phase development (the FAQ says the 1.5 million sq ft is 'planned across a four-phase development'), and the FAQ says the campus 'is built for performance today and expansion tomorrow'. These present-tense statements (water use measured and reported with 2025 monthly bills, round-the-clock on-site staffing, the flagship-campus description and colocation deployments of 250 kW to 30 MW) describe a data center in service; the annualized PUE of 1.18 is one of the listed specifications.
sources.date_semantics: Structured data give datePublished 2021-11-16 and dateModified 2026-09-10T19:19:24Z, matching Novva's page-sitemap lastmod (us-nv-ut-id-p4-novva-page-sitemap). The modification is bounded below by the Internet Archive copy of 14 July 2026 (us-nv-ut-id-p4-novva-utah-page-ia-20260714; dateModified 2026-07-13, the same campus description with the street address and a tour section) and above by this live capture of 26 October 2026; the CDX index has no copy between them. published_at records the modification day, used as a publication-normalised operating observation on 10 September 2026; it is not an opening date. The 1.5 million sq ft, 200 MW and 200,000 sq ft figures are operator design and build-out figures, not observed load or built area.

sources.title: DataBank: Downtown Salt Lake City Data Center (SLC1), 179 E Social Hall Ave page (version modified 29 September 2026)
sources.summary: DataBank's SLC1 page gives 'Downtown Salt Lake City Data Center (SLC1) 179 E Social Hall Ave Suite #200 - Salt Lake City, UT 84111' and says 'DataBank's SLC1 downtown Salt Lake City data center is located in the heart of the downtown business district' and that 'The site is also the primary carrier hotel for the Salt Lake City area, populated with multiple Tier-1 and Tier-2 network providers entering the building through multiple access points.' It lists 10,610 IT square feet, 0.5 MW critical IT load, 38 onsite carriers, N+1 power and cooling, colocation, 7x24x365 hours of operation and remote hands, and invites visitors to tour 'this DataBank data center today'. These present-tense statements describe a facility in service.
